record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Related to Fixed Point Properties
record.context_brief: Amenability characterized by Schauder fixed point property
record.original_question: Which amenability property of a semitopological semigroup is characterized by the Schauder fixed point property (fppS), namely: every jointly continuous representation of the semigroup on a nonempty compact convex subset of a separated locally convex topological vector space has a common fixed point?

evidence.quote: (fppS ) Every jointly continuous representation of S on a nonempty compact convex subset C of a separated locally convex topological vector space has a common fixed point.
Problem 2.11. What amenability property of a semitopological semigroup may be characterized by the Schauder fixed point property (fppS )?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a semitopological semigroup, i.e., a semigroup equipped with a Hausdorff topology such that for each $s \in S$ the maps $t \mapsto st$ and $t \mapsto ts$ from $S$ to $S$ are continuous. A jointly continuous representation of $S$ on a nonempty compact convex subset $C$ of a separated locally convex topological vector space $E$ is a family $\{T_s : s \in S\}$ of continuous self-maps of $C$ satisfying $T_{st} = T_s \circ T_t$ for all $s,t \in S$ and such that the action map $(s,x) \mapsto T_s(x)$ from $S \times C$ to $C$ is jointly continuous. Say that $S$ has the Schauder fixed point property (fppS) if every such jointly continuous representation of $S$ on any nonempty compact convex subset $C$ of any separated locally convex topological vector space admits a common fixed point, i.e., a point $x \in C$ with $T_s(x) = x$ for every $s \in S$.

Identify an amenability-type property $\mathcal{P}$ of semitopological semigroups such that a semitopological semigroup $S$ has the Schauder fixed point property (fppS) if and only if $S$ satisfies $\mathcal{P}$. In other words, characterize the Schauder fixed point property (fppS) for semitopological semigroups by an equivalent amenability property.
artifact.status_search_result: K. Salame's paper "On the Schauder fixed point property" (Annals of Functional Analysis, 2019) provides a partial answer: he proves that the Schauder fixed point property is implied by (and characterized for) the class of n-extremely left amenable semitopological semigroups, with applications to extremely left amenable semigroups, locally finite groups, and semidirect products. A full equivalence with a single amenability property for arbitrary semitopological semigroups does not appear to have been established.

status_evidence.title: On the Schauder fixed point property (Salame)
status_evidence.snippet: Provides a positive answer to the problem of identifying an amenability property characterizing the Schauder fixed point property for the class of n-extremely left amenable semitopological semigroups, with applications to extremely left amenable semigroups, locally finite groups, and semidirect products.
status_evidence.claim: Partial characterization given for n-extremely left amenable semitopological semigroups; general problem not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Strongly amenable semigroups and nonlinear fixed point properties
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates relationships between amenability-type properties of semigroups and nonlinear fixed point properties.
status_evidence.claim: Surrounding literature connects various amenability notions to fixed point properties, but no full characterization of fppS is given.
